title: The Kricketot Mod
body:
Ever felt like Minecraft didn't have enough Kricketots inside? Me too! That's why I created this mod to fix this very problem.

Getting Started:

- Craft 1 End Stone with 1 Jungle Log to create Kricketotium Ore.

- Use a Stone Pickaxe or better to obtain Raw Kricketotium.

- Cook the raw ore in a furnace to get a Kricketotium ingot.

Crafting & Abilities:

- Kricketotium Drum: Craft a Kricketotium ingot on top of a Jungle Log. Right-click it to play music!

- Kricketotium Wand: To create a wand, simply drop a Stick, Blaze Rod, or End Rod on top of the drum.

- Summon Rain: Shift right-click the drum with the wand to perform a ritual and summon rain.

- Transmute Ore: Right-click Copper Ore or Deepslate Copper Ore with the wand to convert it into Kricketotium Ore.

- Destroy Fire: Right-click a fire block with the wand to extinguish it and grow Jungle Leaves in its place.

- Smelt Goods: Surround 1 Blaze Powder with 8 Kricketotium ingots to craft 8 Blazing Kricketotium, a highly efficient fuel source.
